question: When white light is passed through a gas of hydrogen atoms at room temperature, the emerging spectrum shows dark lines on a bright background. Explain the cause of these dark lines.

options.A: The gas atoms emit radiation that interferes destructively with the white light.
options.B: The gas atoms absorb specific wavelengths from the white light to jump to higher energy states.
options.C: The gas atoms scatter the white light in all directions uniformly.
options.D: The white light ionizes the gas, preventing transmission.
